claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (APV-CMV, PEEP 5 cmH2O, FiO2 40%, set rate 14/min) and monitor airway pressures, tidal volumes, and minute ventilation.
Wean FiO2 and monitor SpO2 with a desaturation limit of 88%.
Monitor blood pressure non-invasively given intermittent hypertension and prior hypotension.
Monitor heart rate and rhythm with alarms and ST-segment monitoring.
Continue enteral nutrition with Glucerna 1.2 at approximately 15 mL/hour.
Monitor blood glucose with fingerstick checks and adjust insulin therapy as needed.
Trend troponin T and CK-MB to evaluate mild troponin elevation.
Monitor coagulation studies (PTT, INR, platelets) given prolonged PTT.
Monitor vancomycin trough and renal function to guide dosing.
Perform daily sedation interruption and assess readiness for extubation using Richmond-RAS and spontaneous breathing trials.
